purpose: Map every Phase 00 product acceptance criterion, first-10-minutes pass condition, investment-gate threshold and measurable boundary to a QA verification item with a method, an earliest measurable phase, a contract prerequisite, a fixture requirement and a fix owner. This register is the single QA source of truth; QA_PHASE00_TRACEABILITY_MATRIX.md is a rendered view and must not drift from it.

sourceBaseline.note: Sources are on unmerged track branches at the time of authoring. Commit hashes are recorded so drift can be detected. QA does not own these files and does not edit them.

method.VALIDATOR: Deterministic check over content/data/definitions. No build or player required.
method.BUILD: Automated or scripted check against a built artifact (unit/integration/playmode/device automation).
method.PLAYTEST: Fresh-participant protocol with coded exit answers. Requires cohort >= minimum.
method.EVIDENCE: Produced by another track as measured evidence; QA verifies presence, format and method, not the number.
method.DOC_REVIEW: Structured review of a document against a checklist; result is a finding list, not a pass/fail number.

status.DEFINED: Verification item is specified; nothing can be executed yet.
status.BLOCKED_ON_CONTRACT: Cannot be automated until the named contract family is released.
status.BLOCKED_ON_SOURCE: Cannot be executed until the named upstream artifact exists.
status.EXECUTABLE_NOW: Can be executed against the current repository.
status.EXECUTED_FAIL: Executed; evidence path recorded; failed; finding filed.
status.UNMEASURED: Execution attempted but method could not produce a result.

priority.MUST: Gate-blocking for the phase it is measured in.
priority.SHOULD: Informs scope decisions; does not fail a gate alone.
priority.HARD_STOP: A single failure escalates to Human Product Authority.

idPolicy.rule: Immutable once released with registerVersion 1.0.0. Never renumber, never reuse. Superseding an item appends a new QAT with supersedes set.
idPolicy.requestedRegistration: AI-13 governance ID registry (does not exist yet; see findings register QAF-001).

items.title: Protected-core proof: every critical-path puzzle solvable with all equipment removed
items.criterionText: [BUILD] With all equipment removed from the save, every critical-path puzzle remains solvable by legal moves alone. Required automated regression, owner AI-10.
items.fixtureRequirement: Golden save fixture with empty loadout + list of critical-path puzzle IDs (from AI-03 chapter definitions).
items.notes: Solvability is decided by the deterministic simulation (same seed + move list + rulesetVersion => same result, TECHNICAL_BLUEPRINT.md). Test must not use any solver that reads equipment state.

items.title: Equipment effects never reference or mutate puzzle truth
items.criterionText: [VALIDATOR] No equipment effect definition may reference or mutate puzzle truth (cube permutation state, legal-move set, solved predicate). Effects are consumed via the capability model only.
items.fixtureRequirement: Positive fixture (approved effect categories only) and negative fixture (effect referencing solved predicate) to prove the validator fails correctly.
items.notes: Approved effect categories per PD-002: information, access, interaction, efficiency, risk management, exploration, companion synergy, puzzle strategy. Forbidden: damage, defense, health, attack, any numeric multiplier on puzzle state.

items.title: Zero critical-path items acquired via random drop
items.criterionText: [VALIDATOR] Zero critical-path items are acquired via random drop. Product Lock §10: Critical-path items dependent on random drops = 0.
items.fixtureRequirement: Reward fixture with one deterministic and one seeded-random source; critical-path flag on items.
items.notes: Also covers the Phase 00 prompt requirement: 'Verify no random drop can soft-lock critical progress.' Soft-lock analysis = graph reachability from chapter start to chapter end using deterministic sources only.

items.title: Every equipment item answers >= 2 of the Bible §9 six questions in its identity card
items.criterionText: [VALIDATOR] Every equipment item declares >= 2 affirmative answers to the Bible §9 six-question test, recorded in its item identity card.
items.fixtureRequirement: Item identity card fixture with the six boolean answers as explicit fields.
items.notes: Requires the ItemIdentity contract to carry the six answers as data, not prose. Integration request to AI-02 recorded in findings register.

items.title: Complexity budget counters within cap
items.criterionText: [VALIDATOR] Count of equipment/relic items <= 12; active slots <= 4; upgrade steps per branch <= 2; upgrade branches per item <= 3; item families <= 6; quest states <= 6; world-state tiers per biome <= 5; narrative memory flags per chapter <= 6 and <= 60 total; companions <= 1; player-visible resources <= 1; named set synergies <= 3.
items.fixtureRequirement: Per-contract minimal fixtures; the counting sources are named in CUT §3.
items.notes: PD-003 names AI-13 as report owner fed by AI-02/03/07 data. QA provides the counting validator and the negative fixtures; AI-13 owns the gate verdict.

items.title: Chapter definitions declare one question introduced and >= 1 question advanced/resolved
items.criterionText: [VALIDATOR] Every chapter definition declares exactly one question introduced and at least one question advanced or resolved. Missing either -> validation failure.
items.fixtureRequirement: Chapter definition fixture with questionIntroduced / questionsAdvanced fields.
items.notes: Chapter definition schema does not exist yet; CUT §3 references a `CC.NARRATIVE.CHAPTER` counting source that is not defined anywhere in the repository (see QAF-004).

items.title: Mandatory text budget before first solve and in minutes 0-10
items.criterionText: [VALIDATOR] No mandatory narrative text node before the first solve exceeds 40 words in the source language. No narrative node in minutes 0-10 exceeds 40 words; total mandatory text in minutes 0-10 <= 120 words. No cutscene > 20 s before first solve.
items.fixtureRequirement: Narrative node fixture with mandatory flag, ordering, timing window and source-language text.
items.notes: Word count is counted on the source language only (PD-001). Cutscene duration needs a duration field or timeline metadata in the NarrativeEvent contract (request to AI-09).

items.title: Main story path completable with zero optional lore read
items.criterionText: [VALIDATOR] No critical-path prerequisite references a Memory Collectible, an optional discovery, or a companion bond level.
items.fixtureRequirement: Quest prerequisite fixture with a negative case referencing an optional discovery.
items.notes: Merges three PD criteria with identical mechanics (PD-001 optional lore, PD-005 bond level, PD-006 secrets never block). One validator, three rule IDs.

items.title: Companion reaction triggers limited to approved trigger list
items.criterionText: [VALIDATOR] Companion reaction definitions reference only: puzzle states, biome health, relics, story revelations, mastery moments, player choices. Any other trigger fails.
items.fixtureRequirement: Reaction fixture with one entry per approved trigger class and one forbidden trigger.
items.notes: Also proves CUT-005 (no combat triggers) and CUT-011 (no gift trigger).

items.title: Discovery definitions complete (Secret Design Test) and deterministically reproducible
items.criterionText: [VALIDATOR] Every discovery definition answers notice / skill / reveal / worth as non-empty fields and records a deterministic reproduction path (seed or state sequence).
items.fixtureRequirement: Discovery fixture with reproductionPath as an ordered state/move list.
items.notes: The reproduction path becomes the input of the Phase 05+ automated discovery replay test.

items.title: Save -> kill -> reload preserves puzzle, world, loadout, discovery ledger and memory flags
items.criterionText: [BUILD] 100% of trials restore puzzle state, world state, loadout, discovery ledger and memory flags after save/kill/reload. Any interruption loses at most the in-progress twist animation. Any data loss -> HARD_STOP.
items.fixtureRequirement: Versioned golden save fixtures per released schema; corrupted, truncated, missing-field and future-version variants (SAVE_MIGRATION_POLICY.md).
items.notes: Kill points: mid-twist, mid-save-write, mid-reward-claim, mid-discovery-record. Trials must be repeated >= 20 per kill point; the 100% threshold is per trial, not per cohort.

items.title: Reward and resource duplication impossible via interruption/retry
items.criterionText: Rewards cannot be duplicated through interruption/retry abuse; resource duplication blocked; interrupted reward claims safe.
items.fixtureRequirement: Idempotency fixture: same reward event delivered twice with identical event ID must yield one grant.
items.notes: Requires reward events to carry an idempotency key (EVENT_AND_ID_POLICY.md: events document whether duplication is possible). Request to AI-02/AI-13 recorded.

items.title: Smart Assist never performs a move; assist level persists and is changeable in <= 2 taps
items.criterionText: [VALIDATOR] No assist level definition performs a move on behalf of the player. [BUILD] Assist level changeable mid-puzzle in <= 2 taps and persists in save.
items.fixtureRequirement: Assist level definition fixture with capability list; negative fixture with a `performMove` capability.
items.notes: Assist owner across tracks is UNKNOWN: assist rules are puzzle-side (AI-03), presentation is AI-07 (D-UX-04). Recorded as QAF-005.

items.title: Affinity entries map to approved effect categories; disabling affinity does not change solvability
items.criterionText: [VALIDATOR] Every affinity entry maps to an effect in an approved category; none maps to a numeric multiplier. [BUILD] Disabling the affinity layer does not change any puzzle's solvability. Matrix size <= 12 items x 6 biomes.
items.fixtureRequirement: Affinity matrix fixture; negative entry with a multiplier field.
items.notes: The BUILD half is the same harness as QAT-001 with affinity toggled off.

items.title: Offline completeness: Gold Slice completable in airplane mode
items.criterionText: [BUILD] Full Gold Slice completable in airplane mode with zero network-related dialogs or blocks.
items.fixtureRequirement: Device with radios disabled; scripted playthrough of the slice; dialog/log capture.
items.notes: Also verify WORLDCLASS_QA_EXPANSION Analytics QA: telemetry failure does not break gameplay.

items.title: Puzzle tile identity encoded by >= 2 independent channels
items.criterionText: [VALIDATOR] Puzzle tile identity is encoded by at least two independent channels (e.g., color + glyph/pattern) in the presentation contract.
items.fixtureRequirement: Tile presentation fixture with channel list.
items.notes: Presentation contract owner is AI-04/AI-07; the tile identity data field likely lives in the puzzle presentation DTO. Owner confirmation requested (QAF-005).

items.title: Accessibility smoke test passes in Gold Slice
items.criterionText: [BUILD] Accessibility smoke test (V7.1 §15) passes in the Gold Slice: reduced motion, camera comfort, haptic intensity, larger touch targets, text-speed control, safe-area handling; toggles persist.
items.fixtureRequirement: Preference fixture with every V7.1 §9 setting at non-default value; save/reload; screenshot per screen.
items.notes: Persistence half depends on AccessibilityPreference being part of SaveSchema or a separate settings store — UNKNOWN until Phase 01.

items.title: Zero hard-coded player-facing strings; pseudo-localization +35% shows no clipping
items.criterionText: [VALIDATOR] Zero hard-coded player-facing strings in runtime code (AI-10 lint/validator). [BUILD] Pseudo-localization pass at +35% length shows no clipped text in Gold Slice screens.
items.fixtureRequirement: Localization key fixture; pseudo-locale generator producing +35% expansion.
items.notes: Lint scope must be defined against the actual code layout after Phase 02 bootstrap (no engine project exists yet). The lint will allow-list AI-09's key-lookup API only.

items.title: F10-001 deliberate twist within 90 s; accidental-input complaints <= 5%
items.criterionText: [PLAYTEST] >= 90% of fresh players perform a deliberate face rotation within 90 s without verbal help. <= 5% accidental-input complaints in exit interview.
items.fixtureRequirement: Session record fields: timeToFirstDeliberateTwistMs, accidentalInputComplaint (exit Q6 coding).
items.notes: Field definitions live in fixtures/playtest_session_record.schema.json.

items.title: F10-002 median time-to-first-solve <= 3:00; world reaction <= 2 s
items.criterionText: [PLAYTEST] median time-to-first-solve <= 3:00 from app start (HARD_STOP > 5:00). [BUILD] world reaction begins <= 2 s after solved predicate becomes true.
items.fixtureRequirement: Session record field timeToFirstSolveMs; build-side timestamp pair (solvedPredicateTrueAt, firstWorldReactionAt) logged by AI-02/AI-05 instrumentation.
items.notes: The 2 s causality latency must be measured on the AI-11 low-tier device, not on a workstation.

items.title: F10-003 / IGM-007 causality recognition and unprompted creature mention
items.criterionText: [PLAYTEST] >= 70% describe a concrete world change when asked what solving did; >= 50% mention the creature unprompted.
items.fixtureRequirement: Exit Q2 coding: CONCRETE_WORLD_CHANGE | ABSTRACT_REWARD | UNSURE. Observer log: unpromptedCreatureMention boolean.
items.notes: Two independent raters; disagreement resolved by a third; inter-rater agreement reported.

items.title: F10-004 / IGM-005 story curiosity and no lore-wall complaints
items.criterionText: [PLAYTEST] >= 60% state at least one story/world question they want answered. <= 10% answer yes to 'too much reading or too many cutscenes'.
items.fixtureRequirement: Exit Q3 coding: STORY_WORLD_QUESTION | UI_QUESTION | NONE. Exit Q7 boolean.
items.notes: Validator companion is QAT-007.

items.title: F10-005 / IGM-004 meaningful choice and behavioral equipment value
items.criterionText: [PLAYTEST] >= 70% recognize they made a choice. >= 60% code as behavioral, <= 10% numeric on 'did any object let you do something new'. HARD_STOP: >= 30% describe any equipment as 'made it easier / solved it for me'. [VALIDATOR] the choice writes exactly one narrative memory flag and does not gate the critical path.
items.fixtureRequirement: Exit Q4 coding: BEHAVIORAL | NUMERIC | SOLVED_FOR_ME | NONE. Exit Q4b choice recognition boolean. Flag-count validator on the chapter-1 choice node.
items.notes: SOLVED_FOR_ME is coded separately from NUMERIC because it triggers the IGM-004 HARD_STOP.

items.title: F10-006 progression is more than numbers; no numeric indicator rendered in minutes 0-10
items.criterionText: [PLAYTEST] >= 70% restate the value proposition gist; <= 20% answer progression in terms of numbers/levels; >= 60% in terms of skill/tools/places/story. [BUILD] no numeric progression indicator is rendered in minutes 0-10.
items.fixtureRequirement: Exit Q1 coding (DISTINCT | GENERIC | COMPETITOR_FRAMED); Exit Q5 coding (NUMBERS_LEVELS | SKILL_TOOLS_PLACES_STORY | OTHER). Build-side HUD element inventory captured at 60 s intervals.
items.notes: Q1 coding lists are owned by AI-01 (IGM-003); QA applies them and reports inter-rater agreement.

items.title: F10-007 forced interruption recovery and low-tier frame hitch ceiling
items.criterionText: [BUILD] resume restores exact puzzle state, world state and position after a forced interruption between minutes 2-6. [BUILD] on the AI-11 low-tier device no frame hitch > 100 ms during a twist in minutes 0-10 (HYPOTHESIS until measured).
items.fixtureRequirement: AI-11 device matrix (MISSING in repo); profiler capture method published by AI-11.
items.notes: Frame-time numbers are reported as EVIDENCE from AI-11; QA verifies presence/method per EVIDENCE_STANDARD.md and never fills in a number.

items.title: IGM-001 voluntary continuation and IGM-001b solve ownership
items.criterionText: [PLAYTEST] >= 60% continue >= 3 min unprompted after 'you can stop here or keep going'. >= 70% answer 'me' or 'mix', <= 10% 'game' on solve ownership. HARD_STOP > 30% 'game'. Max-assist users still report 'I figured it out' >= 50%.
items.fixtureRequirement: Session record fields: continuedAfterProtocol, continuationDurationMs, solveOwnership (ME|MIX|GAME), maxAssistUsed.
items.notes: PD-007 acceptance is a sub-group analysis of the same field, so no extra question is asked.

items.title: IGM-002b loadout change task success and PD-003 menu comprehension
items.criterionText: [PLAYTEST] >= 80% change a loadout item without help on first attempt. <= 10% describe menus as confusing/too many. [PLAYTEST] loadout change from gameplay <= 2 taps by UX walkthrough. SHOULD: >= 40% swap a loadout item voluntarily when facing the second biome.
items.fixtureRequirement: Task script + observer fields: loadoutTaskFirstAttemptSuccess, loadoutTapCount, voluntaryLoadoutSwap.
items.notes: Gold Slice only; not part of the first-10-minutes script because F10 forbids forced menus.

items.title: IGM-006 input reliability: unintended actions per 10 minutes
items.criterionText: [BUILD+PLAYTEST] <= 2 unintended face rotations / camera moves per 10 minutes, median across cohort, on mid-tier device. HARD_STOP > 5.
items.fixtureRequirement: Debug counter of unintended actions provided by AI-04 (per IGM-006 'AI-04 to provide'); observer tally as cross-check.
items.notes: Definition of 'unintended' must be operationalised by AI-04's gesture arbitration model before this can be measured; request recorded (QAF-006).

items.title: IGM-008 retention intent proxy with zero dark-pattern reasons
items.criterionText: [PLAYTEST] >= 50% 'yes' to playing again tomorrow; >= 70% of yes/maybe reasons map to the healthy-retention list; 0% cite a timer, reward schedule or FOMO.
items.fixtureRequirement: Exit Q8 coding against Bible §11 list plus DARK_PATTERN bucket.
items.notes: Becomes MUST at Phase 15 with opt-in telemetry D1/D7 (TelemetryEvent, AI-12).

items.title: Product-approved vocabulary and IP rule respected in player-facing and design text
items.criterionText: No rejected/avoid term from Product Lock §6.3 is used affirmatively as CraftCube vocabulary; no proprietary franchise name is used as CraftCube branding, asset name, ID or player-facing string.
items.fixtureRequirement: QA_IP_TERMINOLOGY_RULES.json (QAR-###) with scope-aware severity.
items.notes: Executed by QA_PHASE00_VALIDATOR.py against markdown in the current checkout. Design docs may name rejected terms when negating them; the validator flags only affirmative use in ID/asset/key contexts and reports design-doc mentions as INFO.

items.title: Phase 00 deliverables of other tracks are consumable by QA (structured acceptance criteria present)
items.criterionText: Every PD acceptance criterion carries a [VALIDATOR] / [BUILD] / [PLAYTEST] / [EVIDENCE] tag; every IGM has a threshold, method, owner and phase; every F10 has a pass condition. Any criterion without a method tag is a finding.
items.fixtureRequirement: None; runs against product documents when present in the checkout, otherwise reports SOURCE_NOT_PRESENT.
items.notes: Executed by QA_PHASE00_VALIDATOR.py section 'product-doc cross-check'. Result recorded in evidence/.

items.title: Quest state machine uses exactly the six approved states and every quest has fail/recovery behaviour
items.criterionText: [VALIDATOR] QuestState enum == {DISCOVERED, ACCEPTED, ACTIVE, BLOCKED, RESOLVED, CONSEQUENCE_APPLIED}; every quest definition declares stable ID, owner, prerequisites, fail/recovery behaviour, reward, narrative consequence, save persistence, replay behaviour.
items.fixtureRequirement: Quest fixture with all eight required properties; negative fixture with a seventh state.
items.notes: Quest state ownership conflict C-02 was raised by AI-02; QA waits for AI-13's ruling before writing the fixture.

items.title: Telemetry privacy: no personal data, versioned schema, opt-out honoured, failure is silent to gameplay
items.criterionText: [VALIDATOR] Every TelemetryEvent field is classified (none = personal/sensitive); schema carries version. [BUILD] with telemetry endpoint unreachable, gameplay is unaffected; with opt-out set, zero events leave the device.
items.fixtureRequirement: Event schema fixture with field classification; network-blackhole test harness.
items.notes: Playtest session records produced by QA before Phase 13 are pseudonymous by construction (see fixtures/playtest_session_record.schema.json) and are not telemetry.

items.title: Competitive integrity: impossible scores rejected; trust level explicit; challenge version recorded
items.criterionText: [BUILD] A submitted result whose move list is illegal under rulesetVersion is rejected; every result carries trustLevel in {Local, Device-verified, Server-verified} and challengeDefinitionVersion; no signing secret in the client.
items.fixtureRequirement: Legal and illegal replay fixtures for a fixed seed.
items.notes: Leaderboards are LATER (CUT-023). Item is defined now so the CompetitiveResult contract is testable when it appears.

items.title: Remote content safety: invalid package rejected, rollback works, offline core unaffected
items.criterionText: [BUILD] Package with bad checksum / incompatible schema range is rejected; last-known-good is restored; old save remains readable; failure of an optional package cannot block the core offline game.
items.fixtureRequirement: Manifest fixtures: valid, corrupted checksum, out-of-range schema.
items.notes: Remote content is LATER (CUT-024).

items.title: Economy: <= 1 resource, deterministic source per sink in same chapter, no irreversible loss on failure
items.criterionText: [VALIDATOR] ResourceLedger declares <= 1 resource type; every sink is reachable by a deterministic source within the chapter it is introduced. [PLAYTEST] >= 70% can explain what the resource is for after first acquiring it. [BUILD] no failed attempt reduces the ledger below its pre-attempt value.
items.fixtureRequirement: Ledger fixture with one resource; sink/source graph per chapter.
items.notes: If the Gold Slice cuts the resource (PD-004 fallback), this item is marked superseded rather than deleted.

pdNotTestable.PD-009: DEFERRED_TO_EVIDENCE; its unlock criterion (>= 30% voluntary replay) is observable in QAT-026 continuation data but is a Product scope decision, not a QA gate.
pdNotTestable.PD-014: DEFERRED_TO_HUMAN (monetization). QA enforces the design constraint indirectly through QAT-005 (currency cap) and QAT-036.
pdNotTestable.PD-016: Pointer to cut list; enforced by QAT-005 counters and QAT-030 vocabulary.

igmNotTestable.IGM-003b: Documentation-form competitor review owned by AI-01 + human; QA verifies existence only via QAT-031 doc review.
igmNotTestable.IGM-006e: SHOULD placeholders for AI-11/AI-12 budgets; QA verifies EVIDENCE format only.
